Praise for a long turn
Readers will enjoy floor markings
Travel notes from the Companion Animal Travel Desk

Staff and travelers are seeing calmer handoffs across the companion animal route, with clearer guidance at the counter and a steadier pace in the holding areas. The desk continues to welcome concerns in a warm, professional manner, and the welfare coordinator keeps comfort needs in view while the safety coordinator checks for hazards and prevention. <<FACT F027>> Guidance is also being shared in simple language so that pets and people can move through the process with less strain.

At Port Isolde, <<FACT F021>> the team is keeping an eye on arrivals and making room for steady support. Small updates, such as cleaner floor markings and better placement of carriers, are helping travelers feel oriented from the start. Bailey has been mentioned with a smile by more than one staff member, and the same thoughtful care is being extended to every visiting pet. Aurelia Skyways remains committed to a reassuring experience for all.
